text_simplified: This text addresses the Prophetic tarbiyah (upbringing) curriculum derived from the seerah of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. It aims to extract the general characteristics of this curriculum and the most important tarbiyah methods he used. The research focuses on analyzing these characteristics and their applications in the upbringing of individuals and communities. Parents can benefit from these principles in raising their children upon a comprehensive Islamic foundation.

review_defects.why: Arabic uses the adjective 'التربوي' (educational/pedagogical), not the noun 'tarbiyah'. Translating it as 'Tarbiyah Curriculum' introduces a transliterated noun not present in the source; a more accurate rendering would be 'The Prophetic Educational Methodology' or 'The Prophetic Tarbawiy Curriculum'.

review_defects.english: the most important tarbiyah methods he used
review_defects.why: Same issue: 'التربوية' is an adjective meaning educational, not the noun 'tarbiyah'. Using 'tarbiyah methods' is inconsistent with the later translation of 'تربية' as 'upbringing'.
Arabic plural 'أسس' (foundations/bases) is rendered as singular 'foundation', and 'وفق' (according to) is changed to 'upon'. This slightly alters the meaning.
